headline: This law renames a New York VA hospital campus in Manhattan after Margaret Cochran Corbin, a Revolutionary War veteran.
what_it_does: The law changes the official name of the Manhattan Campus of the New York Harbor Health Care System, part of the Department of Veterans Affairs. The campus will now be called the Margaret Cochran Corbin Campus of the New York Harbor Health Care System, also known as the Margaret Cochran Corbin VA Campus. The law does not change how care is provided, who is eligible, or how the campus is run.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on January 13, 2021.
